entries.en: We must allow for traffic when planning the journey.
entries.zh: 规划行程时，我们必须考虑交通状况。

entries.en: The buses stopped running, and so we walked home.
entries.zh: 公交车停运了，因此我们步行回家。

entries.en: The revised timetable takes effect as of next Monday.
entries.zh: 修订后的时刻表从下周一开始生效。

entries.en: Send me a message as soon as you reach the station.
entries.zh: 你一到车站就给我发条消息。

entries.en: Please ask for a receipt when you pay.
entries.zh: 付款时请索要收据。

entries.en: After years of quarrelling, the two families were finally at peace.
entries.zh: 争吵多年后，这两个家庭终于和睦相处了。

entries.en: She borrowed an introductory book on atomic physics.
entries.zh: 她借了一本原子物理学入门书。

entries.en: The class marked the autumnal equinox on its calendar.
entries.zh: 班上的同学在日历上标出了秋分。

entries.en: Back away slowly and give the frightened dog some space.
entries.zh: 慢慢退后，给那只受惊的狗留出一些空间。

entries.en: I can bang out a rough draft before lunch.
entries.zh: 我能在午饭前赶出一份初稿。

entries.en: The final payment will be due next Friday.
entries.zh: 最后一笔款项将于下周五到期。

entries.en: Several volunteers worked behind the scenes to keep the festival running.
entries.zh: 几名志愿者在幕后工作，确保节日活动顺利进行。

entries.en: Please give the volunteers a big hand for their work.
entries.zh: 请为志愿者的工作报以热烈掌声。

entries.en: Visitors must stay on the marked paths in the bird sanctuary.
entries.zh: 游客在鸟类保护区内必须沿标示的步道行走。

entries.en: We treated the program as a black box and tested its outputs.
entries.zh: 我们把这个程序当作黑盒子，测试了它的输出。

entries.en: The family boasted of its blue blood but had little money.
entries.zh: 这个家庭以贵族血统自夸，却没有多少钱。

entries.en: The programme includes a cast of characters on the first page.
entries.zh: 节目单第一页列有演员表。

entries.en: You should charge up the camera before the trip.
entries.zh: 出发前你应该给相机充好电。

entries.en: They cling to the hope that their dog will return.
entries.zh: 他们仍抱着狗会回来的希望，不愿放弃。

entries.en: Rinse the vegetables in cold water before cutting them.
entries.zh: 切菜前先用冷水冲洗蔬菜。

entries.en: The quiet square will come alive when the musicians arrive.
entries.zh: 乐手到来时，安静的广场就会热闹起来。

entries.en: Please come around after work if you have time.
entries.zh: 如果有时间，请下班后过来坐坐。

entries.en: You can come over once the repairs are finished.
entries.zh: 维修结束后，你就可以过来了。

entries.en: We will review any documents that come to hand before Friday.
entries.zh: 我们会审阅周五前收到的所有文件。

entries.en: The injured bird seemed to come to life as it warmed up.
entries.zh: 随着身体暖和起来，那只受伤的鸟似乎苏醒了。

entries.en: The rising water began to come up to the bottom step.
entries.zh: 不断上涨的水开始升到最下面一级台阶。

entries.en: I would rather confide in a friend than post everything online.
entries.zh: 我宁愿向朋友倾诉，也不愿把一切都发到网上。

entries.en: The report contains confidential information and should not be shared.
entries.zh: 这份报告含有机密情报，不应传给他人。

entries.en: His question about everyone's salary was a conversation stopper.
entries.zh: 他询问每个人薪水的那句话让大家一时无言以对。

entries.en: Could you cover for me at the front desk?
entries.zh: 你能替我在前台值班吗？

entries.en: The recipe calls for a small piece of crystallized ginger.
entries.zh: 这个食谱需要一小块蜜饯生姜。

entries.en: Please do not cut into our conversation with another joke.
entries.zh: 请不要再拿笑话打断我们的谈话。

entries.en: Enter each cash payment in the day book.
entries.zh: 把每笔现金付款记入日记账。

entries.en: She compared the yield on a debenture bond with the bank's deposit rate.
entries.zh: 她把一只无担保债券的收益率与银行存款利率作了比较。

entries.en: The model aircraft has a broad delta wing.
entries.zh: 这架模型飞机装有宽阔的三角形机翼。

entries.en: She expects the little shop to do well over the summer.
entries.zh: 她预计这家小店在夏季会经营得不错。

entries.en: Stir a little double cream into the soup before serving.
entries.zh: 上桌前，在汤里拌入少许高脂肪浓奶油。

entries.en: The cinema is showing a double feature on Saturday night.
entries.zh: 这家电影院将在周六晚上连映两部影片。

entries.en: Workers will dredge up the silt blocking the harbour entrance.
entries.zh: 工人将挖出堵塞港口入口的淤泥。

entries.en: The crowd began to drop away after the final speech.
entries.zh: 最后一场演讲结束后，人群开始散去。

entries.en: The caller mistook her for an easy mark.
entries.zh: 打电话来的人误以为她很容易上钩。

entries.en: The unfinished argument continued to eat at him.
entries.zh: 那场尚未解决的争论继续折磨着他。

entries.en: Rising transport costs eat into the shop's narrow profit margin.
entries.zh: 不断上涨的运输成本侵蚀着这家店本已微薄的利润。

entries.en: The painting looks different under electric light.
entries.zh: 这幅画在电光照明下看起来不一样。

entries.en: There is an electric socket behind the desk.
entries.zh: 书桌后面有一个电源插座。

entries.en: The new entertainment center has a cinema and a bowling alley.
entries.zh: 新的娱乐中心设有电影院和保龄球馆。

entries.en: The coach thinks we have an even chance of winning.
entries.zh: 教练认为我们获胜和落败的机会各占一半。

entries.en: An eye infection kept him away from swimming practice.
entries.zh: 眼部感染使他无法参加游泳训练。

entries.en: Within the family circle, she felt free to discuss her worries.
entries.zh: 在家人中间，她可以自在地谈论自己的烦恼。

entries.en: Use the far left drawer for spare keys.
entries.zh: 把备用钥匙放在最左边的抽屉里。

entries.en: We can fire up the stove after the chimney has been checked.
entries.zh: 烟囱检查完毕后，我们就能点起炉子了。

entries.en: The exercise asks for the first moment of a discrete distribution.
entries.zh: 这道练习要求计算一个离散分布的一次矩。

entries.en: He would flirt with her whenever they met at the cafe.
entries.zh: 每次在咖啡馆遇到她，他都会和她调情。

entries.en: Please do not fob off the customer with another vague promise.
entries.zh: 请不要再用一个含糊的承诺搪塞顾客。

entries.en: Without new orders, the small workshop may fold up.
entries.zh: 如果没有新订单，这家小作坊可能会倒闭。

entries.en: Raise the number to the fourth power before comparing the results.
entries.zh: 先求这个数的四次方，再比较结果。

entries.en: The old boat rolled from side to side in the waves.
entries.zh: 那条旧船在波浪中左右摇晃。

entries.en: The council plans to improve garbage disposal in rural areas.
entries.zh: 地方议会计划改善农村地区的垃圾处置工作。

entries.en: Farmers work late to gather in the harvest before the storm.
entries.zh: 农民忙到很晚，赶在暴风雨前把庄稼收回来。

entries.en: Doubts about the decision began to gnaw at her confidence.
entries.zh: 对这个决定的疑虑开始侵蚀她的信心。

entries.en: The team began to go to pieces after losing its captain.
entries.zh: 失去队长后，这个团队开始瓦解。

entries.en: The cafe could go under if it loses its biggest customer.
entries.zh: 如果失去最大的客户，这家咖啡馆可能会破产。

entries.en: The used bicycle turned out to be a good deal.
entries.zh: 事实证明，买下这辆二手自行车是笔划算的交易。

entries.en: You can collect the form from the government office nearby.
entries.zh: 你可以到附近的政府机构领取表格。

entries.en: The green-eyed monster stirred when he saw his rival's new award.
entries.zh: 看到对手新得的奖项时，他心中的嫉妒冒了出来。

entries.en: Old grease can gum up the tiny gears inside the clock.
entries.zh: 陈旧的油脂可能使钟内的微小齿轮卡住。

entries.en: They chose a quiet holiday resort away from the main road.
entries.zh: 他们选了一个远离主路的安静度假区。

entries.en: The athletes returned to home territory after the overseas tour.
entries.zh: 海外巡回活动结束后，运动员们回到了本土。

entries.en: Residents asked to see the details of the new housing project.
entries.zh: 居民要求查看新的住房建造计划的细节。

entries.en: The guests left in good spirits after the reunion.
entries.zh: 聚会结束后，客人们兴致勃勃地离开了。

entries.en: The workers agreed to receive part of their wages in kind.
entries.zh: 工人们同意用实物领取一部分工资。

entries.en: The form has a space for the legal guardian's signature.
entries.zh: 表格上留有法定监护人签名的位置。

entries.en: The rescuer threw a life line to the swimmer near the rocks.
entries.zh: 救援人员向礁石附近的游泳者抛出了一根救生索。

entries.en: The survey asks whether each respondent is a married person.
entries.zh: 调查询问每位受访者是否为已婚人士。

entries.en: The essay examines radio as a mass medium.
entries.zh: 这篇文章考察了作为大众传播工具的广播。

entries.en: The email supplied the missing link in the chain of evidence.
entries.zh: 这封邮件补上了证据链中缺少的一环。

entries.en: The chapter compares one monetary system with another.
entries.zh: 这一章将一种货币制度与另一种作比较。

entries.en: Small delivery charges can mount up over the course of a year.
entries.zh: 一年的时间里，一笔笔小额配送费可能累积成一大笔开销。

entries.en: The first-aid course included a discussion of mouth-to-mouth resuscitation.
entries.zh: 这门急救课程包括对口对口复苏的讨论。
